name: ask_suite_heldout_v1
method: held-out: written by Claude (Opus) from the gold transcripts after the Ask retrieval parameters were tuned on ask_suite_v1; each answer span at least 60 s away from every ask_suite_v1 span of its meeting, facts not asked there; same format and rules as ask_suite_v1 (tools/quality-eval/SPEC.md)

questions.q: 交警年終會議上，事故科說主要路段尖峰時段發生的事故大約佔總事故的多少比例？
questions.answer: 百分之四十多，大部分是小刮小蹭引起的纠纷

questions.q: 交警會議裡有人提到別的城市怎麼處罰闖紅燈的人？
questions.answer: 让闯红灯的人去路口指挥交通一个小时

questions.q: 在安全知識討論的食品安全部分，為什麼說露天經營的食品不能買？
questions.answer: 露天经营的食品一般没有防蝇防尘措施

questions.q: 安全知識討論會講消防知識時，火災分成幾類？D類火災指的是什麼？
questions.answer: 分四类，D类是金属火灾（如铝镁合金）

questions.q: 商場經理的部門會議裡，男裝部說從模特兒身上換下來的快過時舊款怎麼處理？
questions.answer: 挂到架子上打上特价签，搞个活动

questions.q: 商場會議中家電部說，顧客對介紹的產品滿意之後可以提供什麼服務？
questions.answer: 提供上门安装

questions.q: 美容院開業會議裡，針對男女一起來的情侶套餐，首次來店給什麼折扣？
questions.answer: 情侣套餐首次来打五折

questions.q: 美容院會議後段討論賣理療儀時，舉例說做一次收多少錢、買一台儀器要多少錢？
questions.answer: 做一次收二百块，仪器两千块

questions.q: 工廠年關安全會議上，負責消防的部門說消防工作的主要方針是什麼？
questions.answer: 预防为主，防消结合

questions.q: 工廠安全會議中，主管要求年關期間保安巡邏要怎麼加強？
questions.answer: 晚上增加一次或两次巡逻班次

questions.q: 商場樓層主管的季度早會上，男裝部說這個月銷量不高的原因是什麼？
questions.answer: 疫情影响，大家在家，线上直播比实体店更火爆

questions.q: 商場季度會議中提出的轉盤抽獎活動，消費滿五百可以抽幾次獎？
questions.answer: 五次（满三百抽三次）

questions.q: In the second remote control design meeting, what kind of design did the project manager recall the team discussing last time to keep the remote small and uncluttered?
questions.answer: A flip-open design, with a reduced size and an electronic panel for extra features like programming.

questions.q: In the remote control functional design meeting, what games console example was given to argue that controllers may need different sizes for different countries?
questions.answer: The Xbox needed two controller sizes because people in Japan have smaller hands and would not buy the big one.

questions.q: In the remote control functional design meeting, how long is the code from the TV guide that the project manager suggested typing in to record a programme?
questions.answer: A five or six digit number printed after the programme in the TV guide.

questions.q: In the final remote control prototype presentation, what standard colour did the designer suggest for the remote underneath the rubber casing?
questions.answer: Something fairly neutral, like white or light blue.

questions.q: In the remote control prototype finance discussion, why does the remote have a slightly flattened bottom?
questions.answer: So it can sit on a surface and does not roll over.

questions.q: At the end of the final remote control project meeting, roughly what profit did the project manager say the product looked set to make?
questions.answer: About fifty percent profit, with costs below budget.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, which feature did the project manager recall the interface designer proposing so small children can't watch unsuitable channels?
questions.answer: A channel lock.

questions.q: In the remote control design meeting, what example of a remote that can't be lost did the interface designer show?
questions.answer: A jumbo, over-sized universal remote that is impossible to misplace.

questions.q: At the end of the remote control design meeting, what material are the two designers told to use to build the prototype?
questions.answer: Modelling clay; the next meeting is in thirty minutes.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, where did the interface designer want to place the channel up and down buttons?
questions.answer: Where the user's thumb rests, so channels can easily be shifted up or down.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how did the team settle the choice between a wooden and a black-grey remote?
questions.answer: Make one standard remote with changeable case covers, like mobile phones, sold in wood and other colours.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, which case shape did the project manager suggest, and why?
questions.answer: The single curved case, because the curve is good for holding the screen so elderly users can see it easily.

questions.q: 會議中決定公司尾牙要請哪位歌手來表演？
會議裡提到新產品的保固期是幾年？
Which hotel did the team book for the sales conference in Madrid?
How many new engineers did the meeting agree to hire next quarter?
